theme.primary_archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (adapted for Light mode base with Dark Mode toggle)
theme.aesthetic: High-end streetwear, editorial minimalism, quiet luxury

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none

product_card.style: Flat, cardless, aspect-[3/4] image container, no visible borders until hover
product_card.hover_effect: Image scale 105% duration-700 ease-out, reveal Quick Add button
product_card.typography: Left aligned, price and title in Outfit font

buttons.primary: rounded-none bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-8 py-4 uppercase text-xs tracking-widest hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all
buttons.secondary: rounded-none border border-border bg-transparent hover:bg-secondary transition-all

motion_and_interactions.global: Lenis smooth scrolling (mandatory for premium feel)
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer Motion staggered fade-up for hero elements
motion_and_interactions.drawer: Right-side slide-in for Cart and Mobile Menu

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lenis' for momentum smooth scrolling to establish a premium feel.
Use 'framer-motion' for staggered fade-in animations on sections and hero.
Implement a dark/light mode toggle that updates root CSS variables based on the provided colors.
Use 'lucide-react' icons with stroke-width 1.5 for minimalist UI icons (cart, search, wishlist).
Ensure all product images maintain a consistent 3:4 aspect ratio using object-cover.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='wishlist-button').
Do NOT use thick borders or heavy shadows. Rely on generous padding, typography scaling, and negative space for hierarchy.
Always use the exact image URLs provided in the media object; DO NOT use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
